_doc: Visual action events extracted from scene source code for SFX synchronization. Each entry documents the scene JS source, the animation keyframe or parameter that defines the visual contact moment, and the resulting absolute timestamp used by sound-design.py.
_limitations: Scene05 Y_KEYS/IMPACTS are read from scene05.js source code, not from rendered frame inspection.
Scene08 p-based phases (bite/glint/drop) are read from scene08.js source code, not from playback.
Scene03 flyingCoin repeating cycle is read from scene03.js source code; actual coin-land timing depends on scene duration parameter d passed at render time.

Nun footsteps in sc02/sc12 are not visually verified against rendered walking animation; step placement uses evenly-spaced timing within the scene middle portion, matching the actor rig's walking cadence assumption but not frame-level contact verification.
No final encoded playback was performed to confirm audio-visual sync.

coin_events.source_mechanism: flyingCoin(): repeating cycle period P=1.02, coin lands at phase 0.62 of each cycle. First landing at local u=0.6324s. The sort motion repeats continuously, so there is no single definitive 'the coin impact'. We place the SFX at the first landing moment.
coin_events.confidence: medium — repeating animation, first-cycle landing chosen; actual render timing depends on d parameter

coin_events.source_mechanism: Y_KEYS: coin Y reaches REST_Y=1152 at local u=1.6 (first 'in' ease). IMPACTS[0] = {t:1.6, s:1.0} confirms this is the strongest visual impact with ring/puff FX. Coin is held in fingers u<0.85, released, falls to tray at u=1.6.
coin_events.basis: source-code keyframe (Y_KEYS[2] and IMPACTS[0], absolute local time, not normalized)
coin_events.confidence: high — explicit keyframe and impact FX array in source

coin_events.source_mechanism: bite = ease(clamp((p - 0.38) / 0.18)) where p = u/d. Bite begins at p=0.38 (coin contacts slot mechanism). glint peaks at p=0.48 (metallic flash). drop at p=0.54 (coin passes through). All use p=u/d (normalized). We target the glint moment (p=0.48) as the audible metallic contact.
coin_events.basis: source-code animation phase (p=u/d normalized, bite/glint/drop phases)
coin_events.confidence: high — explicit animation phases in source, glint is the visible metallic contact flash

footstep_events.basis: Scene directions specify Nun WALKING (sc02: 'Nun WALKING into her night shift', sc12: 'WALKING 2-3 deliberate steps'). Footstep placement uses evenly-spaced timing in the middle portion of each scene.
footstep_events.visual_verification: NOT verified — footstep timing is cadence-estimated, not matched to rendered foot-contact frames. Scene02/12 owners still finishing visual work.
footstep_events.limitation: Cannot claim step contacts are visually verified while scene02/12 visual owners are still finalizing animation.

cloth_rustle_events.basis: Cloth motion described in scene directions. Placement at ~30% into scene aligns with cloth appearance/sway onset in each scene's narrative arc.
